title: "1 John"

# 1 John

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

1 John provides assurance of salvation while teaching that genuine faith is evidenced by obedience, love, and confidence in Christ.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">1 John 1:9</div>

<div class="identifier">If we confess our sins</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most quoted verses on forgiveness

### Chapter Insight

This chapter emphasizes fellowship with God through walking in the light. The key verse teaches that confession of sin brings forgiveness and cleansing through Christ.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">1 John 2:15</div>

<div class="identifier">Love not the world</div>

### Why This Verse

Christian separation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter encourages obedience, love, and faithfulness to Christ. The key verse highlights Jesus as the advocate for believers and warns against loving the world.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">1 John 3:1</div>

<div class="identifier">Behold, what manner of love</div>

### Why This Verse

Identity as children of God

### Chapter Insight

This chapter celebrates believers' identity as children of God. The key verse emphasizes that genuine faith produces righteous living and love for others.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">1 John 4:8</div>

<div class="identifier">God is love</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most famous statements in Scripture

### Chapter Insight

This chapter teaches discernment and the nature of God's love. The key verse declares that God is love and that His love should be reflected in believers.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">1 John 5:13</div>

<div class="identifier">That ye may know that ye have eternal life</div>

### Why This Verse

Assurance of salvation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter affirms assurance of salvation through faith in Christ. The key verse emphasizes that eternal life is found in God's Son.
:::
